flow cytometry assay.readouts: frequencies of antigen-specific B and T cell populations, innate cell populations, activation markers, and intracellular proteins/cytokines

evidence.quote: Flow cytometry analysis was done on either heparinized whole blood or cryopreserved PBMCs.

enzyme-linked immunospot assay.readouts: antigen-specific IFN-γ, IL-4, and IL-21 spot-forming cells after stimulation with VZV lysate or VZV peptide pool

evidence.section: Zostavax®-specific IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 ELISPOT
evidence.quote: Cryopreserved cells (3–5×10 5 /well) were resuspended in RPMI 1640 + 10% human AB serum (Sigma Aldrich), penicillin, streptomycin, L-glutamine and 2-mercaptoethanol and added to each plate, stimulated with either media alone, 0.25 μg of VZV cell lysate (Meridian Life Sciences - Strain Ellen grade II detergent free) or VZV HLA-A2-restricted peptide pool

evidence.section: Zostavax®-specific and total IgG B cell ELISPOT
evidence.quote: Freshly prepared PBMCs were resuspended in complete FBS media at 1×10 7 /ml and added to each well, followed by threefold dilution and then incubated overnight at 37°C.

enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.readouts: VZV-specific IgG and IgA antibody titers

evidence.quote: Plasma samples were serially diluted in blocking buffer and incubated for 1.5 hr at room temperature.

real time polymerase chain reaction assa.readouts: VZV DNA detection and copy number, with strain identification by amplicon sequence

evidence.quote: PCR was carried out using 200 ng of extracted DNA in 5 μL of water and 15 μL Master Mix containing 50 mM Tris-Cl (pH8.3), 10 mM KCl, 5 mM (NH 4 ) 2 SO 4 , 2 mM MgCl 2 , 200 mM of each deoxynucleoside triphosphate, 0.5 μM of each primer, and 1.25 U of FasStart Taq DNA polymerase (Roche).

amplicon sequencing assay.sample_type: PCR amplicons from random positive samples
amplicon sequencing assay.readouts: amplicon sequence including codon 958 of ORF62 to distinguish vaccine strain from wild type varicella

evidence.quote: The type of VZV DNA detected was identified on random positive samples by partial sequencing of amplicons to include codon 958 of ORF62, which distinguishes vaccine strain VZV (V-Oka) from wild type varicella
Luminex assays were performed with the Beadlyte Human 10-Plex Multi-Cytokine Detection System (Upstate).

additional_evidence.readouts: cytokines and chemokines including IL-6, TNF, CXCL8, CCL2, CXCL9 and CXCL10

evidence.section: In vitro stimulation of PBMCs with Zostavax®
evidence.quote: Cell-free culture supernatants collected were analyzed for cytokines and chemokines, including IL-6, TNF, CXCL8, CCL2, CXCL9 and CXCL10 using Cytokine Bead Array (CBA) kits (BD Biosciences, San Diego, US)
Samples, after quality control, were hybridized on Human U133 Plus 2.0 Arrays (Affymetrix).

metabolomics by mass spectrometry assay.readouts: metabolite peaks and metabolite identities under positive and negative electrospray ionization

evidence.quote: Mass spectral data were collected with a 10-minute reversed phase gradient on a Thermo Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher, San Diego, CA) set to record from mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) 85 to 2000.
Metabolite confirmation was performed with tandem MS-MS experiments on Thermo QE HF, Orbitrap Fusion, or Finnigan LTQ FT Ultra mass spectrometers.
